question: Oda-sensei, please save me. Akainu is standing right behind me. What do I do? from T. Junpei
answer: Calm down. I'm going to teach you a move that will allow you to escape this threat. First, turn your mouth into a "3" and stare into the direction of your upper left. Then, begin to whistle. This move will likely allow you to escape most enemies, ghosts, evil spirits and the like.
